get_candles.description: Get an Upbit market's price candles (open, high, low, close, volume and value) of 1 second to 1 year each, the latest or those before a time, newest first, with the change across them.

mock_response.summary: 3 ETH/BTC candles of 1 day each, from 2026-10-29T00:00:00Z to 2026-10-31T00:00:00Z; latest close 0.02908968 BTC, +0.53% across them.

parameters.name: interval

get_order_book.description: Get the best buy and sell orders waiting on an Upbit market, up to 30 prices a side, with the best bid and ask, the spread and the mid price. A won market's orders can be grouped by a price level, such as every 100,000 KRW.

mock_response.summary: BTC/KRW: best bid 103,800,000 KRW, best ask 103,900,000 KRW, 3 levels a side, grouped by 100,000 KRW.

description: Read Upbit's public market data: the price and day's change of any Korean won, bitcoin or tether market or all of them at once, price candles from 1 second to 1 year, recent trades, the order book, price steps, and the markets Upbit lists with their Korean and English names and warning flags. Start a workflow when a price crosses a level or a new market is listed. No account or API key required.

upbit_new_market_trigger.description: Runs once for each market Upbit adds, in Korean won, bitcoin or tether, soon after it appears in Upbit's market list. Markets already listed when you turn it on never start it.
